title: A Sigil for the Oath
author: Zephyrine Villalobos
blurb: Astrid Halloran, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
